title: Recapitalisation of Remote Monitoring System in Lighthouses under Mumbai, Goa, Cochin, Chennai, Visakhapatnam and Kolkata Directorates
summary: DGLL headquarters open e-tender (two-cover, IT works) for recapitalisation of the remote monitoring system of lighthouses under the Mumbai, Goa, Cochin, Chennai, Visakhapatnam and Kolkata Directorates, with a 730-day period of work.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate General of Lighthouses and Lightships, Head Quarter, Noida

scope.item: Recapitalisation of Remote Monitoring System in Lighthouses under Mumbai, Goa, Cochin, Chennai, Visakhapatnam and Kolkata Directorates

money.notes: EMD Rs 75,00,000 fixed, by Bank Guarantee/DD/FDR payable to PAO, LHLS Noida at Noida; EMD exemption allowed. Tender fee Nil. Tender value shown as NA.

notes: Document is only the CPPP 'Tender Details' printout (27-Dec-2024 15:27), not the tender document; tender.pdf (11.6 MB) and BOQ_884652.xls referenced but not included. Clarification period 27.12.2024 15:00 to 07.01.2025 14:00; pre-bid 08.01.2025 14:30 at Deep Bhawan, A-13 Sector 24, Noida; download/submission end 20.01.2025 15:00. The printout's 'Bid Opening Date' reads 27-Dec-2024 03:25 PM (same as print time, evidently not a real opening date), so bid_opening left null; listing also shows opening 2024-12-27.
